items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...They had John Thomas. Do you remember John Thomas, the trombone player, in Chicago? [INTERVIEWEE] Mmm-hmm.

ctx.x: It had Cassino Simpson on piano, and Scoville Browne on saxophone, they had Jerome Pasquall on saxophone. They had John Thomas. Do you remember John Thomas, the trombone player, in Chicago?
